SpireOddities:TightKnot.NAME: Tight Knot
SpireOddities:TightKnot.FLAVOR: A little tension keeps everything together.
DESCRIPTIONS: Every 3rd card you play each turn grants you #b3 Block.

SpireOddities:CrackedWaxSeal.NAME: Cracked Wax Seal
SpireOddities:CrackedWaxSeal.FLAVOR: It was meant to keep something in.
DESCRIPTIONS: The first time you Exhaust a card each turn, gain #b3 Block.

SpireOddities:InvertedHourglass.NAME: Inverted Hourglass
SpireOddities:InvertedHourglass.FLAVOR: The sand falls upward, but time still runs out.
DESCRIPTIONS: The first time you shuffle your draw pile each combat, gain #b1 Energy and draw #b2 cards.

SpireOddities:FineCopperChain.NAME: Fine Copper Chain
SpireOddities:FineCopperChain.FLAVOR: A little thin, but it holds.
DESCRIPTIONS: After you play a Skill, your next Attack deals #b4 additional damage.

SpireOddities:WornBandage.NAME: Worn Bandage
SpireOddities:WornBandage.FLAVOR: It tears before the wound does.
DESCRIPTIONS: The first time you become Bloodied each combat, heal #b4 HP.

SpireOddities:EmptyFlask.NAME: Empty Flask
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever you use a Potion, gain #b1 Strength.

SpireOddities:AshPouch.NAME: Ash Pouch
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever you Exhaust a Status or Curse, deal #b6 damage to ALL enemies.

SpireOddities:PatchedLeather.NAME: Patched Leather
SpireOddities:PatchedLeather.FLAVOR: Every stitch came from an escape.
DESCRIPTIONS: At Rest Sites, heal #b4 additional HP when you Rest.

SpireOddities:LooseButton.NAME: Loose Button
SpireOddities:LooseButton.FLAVOR: It once held something much larger together.
DESCRIPTIONS: At the end of your turn, if you have at least #b5 cards in hand, gain #b4 Block.

SpireOddities:BentNail.NAME: Bent Nail
DESCRIPTIONS: After you play a 0-cost Attack, it deals #b5 additional damage.

SpireOddities:FoldedFan.NAME: Folded Fan
DESCRIPTIONS: If you play no Attacks during a turn, draw #b2 additional cards at the start of your next turn.

SpireOddities:SealedLetter.NAME: Sealed Letter
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever you obtain a Power, gain #b10 Gold.

SpireOddities:CopperBell.NAME: Copper Bell
SpireOddities:CopperBell.FLAVOR: It rings only when danger draws near.
DESCRIPTIONS: The first time you kill an enemy each combat, draw #b2 cards.

SpireOddities:WaxedThread.NAME: Waxed Thread
SpireOddities:WaxedThread.FLAVOR: Wax lets it slip through the thickest hide.
DESCRIPTIONS: Every 3rd card you manually discard gives you #b1 Energy.

SpireOddities:RustyCompass.NAME: Rusty Compass
SpireOddities:RustyCompass.FLAVOR: The needle points where you just were.
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever you enter an Event room, gain #b15 Gold.

SpireOddities:Paperweight.NAME: Paperweight
SpireOddities:Paperweight.FLAVOR: The paper is light. The Spire is not.
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of your turn, if your draw pile has #b5 or fewer cards, gain #b1 Energy.

SpireOddities:SpareKey.NAME: Spare Key
SpireOddities:SpareKey.FLAVOR: There is always a lock for one more key.
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever you open a non-Boss Chest, obtain a random Potion.

SpireOddities:GoldenThread.NAME: Golden Thread
SpireOddities:GoldenThread.FLAVOR: Some things can still be stitched together.
DESCRIPTIONS: The first time you gain #b10 or more Block at once each turn, gain #b1 Energy.

SpireOddities:ClockworkFeather.NAME: Clockwork Feather
SpireOddities:ClockworkFeather.FLAVOR: Even a feather can be wound.
DESCRIPTIONS: The first time your draw pile becomes empty each combat, draw #b2 cards.

SpireOddities:CinderCrown.NAME: Cinder Crown
DESCRIPTIONS: Every 3rd card you Exhaust gives you #b1 Strength.

SpireOddities:ArchivistSeal.NAME: Archivist's Seal
DESCRIPTIONS: Card Rewards contain #b1 additional card.

SpireOddities:LeadCounterweight.NAME: Lead Counterweight
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of each combat, gain #b2 Strength. At the start of your first turn, lose #b1 Energy.

SpireOddities:EmptyDiceCup.NAME: Empty Dice Cup
DESCRIPTIONS: If you end your turn with no cards in hand, gain #b1 Energy and draw #b1 card at the start of your next turn.
